title: The universe is composed solely of events arranged as a tree

statements.text: An event universe, made solely of events such as outcomes of observables, is represented by a dendrogram, and in the limit of infinitely many events by the p-adic tree, whose ultrametric couples all events through the tree structure.

sources.quote: Such an event universe is represented by a dendrogram (a finite tree) and in the limit of infinitely many events by the p-adic tree
